description: Breakbeat player: a loaded drum loop is split into sixteen slices and played in an order set by a voltage, in time with an incoming clock

params.text: Picks which of the five loaded loops plays
Attenuates the SAMPLE selection CV, from nothing through to its full range

inputs.text: The clock the loop follows, taken at sixteenth notes; the tempo is worked out from the time between two rising edges
A rising edge returns playback to the start of the loop
Picks which of the sixteen slices plays next, 0-10V across the loop; below about 0.6V the playback runs on undisturbed
Adds to the loop selection after its attenuator, 0-10V spanning the five loops
A rising edge jumps to the slice chosen by SEQ without waiting for the next clock, which is how a slice is repeated within a beat
Above 5V playback runs backwards through the loop

outputs.text: The left channel of the loop being played
The right channel of the loop being played

notes: the outputs stay silent until a loop is loaded into one of the five slots under Samples in the right-click menu
a loaded loop is treated as eight beats long whatever its actual length, so a loop of another length plays at the wrong speed
menu: Samples — the five numbered items under this label each load a WAV file into that slot, and each prints the filename it holds
Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.4: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 5V · stepped · one channel only
